name: Food and cooking (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 30 questions on food and cooking, written by Claude. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-03, from its own knowledge: no API call and no source document. Then fact-checked item by item by a second Claude pass on 2026-10-03 (each item's `source` says what it rests on: the page the fact-check found, or "common knowledge" where it judged the fact certain without citing a document; `checked` keeps who checked it and what was fixed). A person still reviews it by playing. On 2026-10-07 every item whose `source` said "common knowledge" was given a real source instead: a page fetched that day that states the fact, with the supporting phrase quoted in `source.note` (each such item's `checked.fixed` records the change).

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.
